title: Athan audio manifest v1
description: Bundled Athan sounds: AAC-LC 96 kbps .m4a at -16 LUFS under assets/athan/ (DESIGN.md §9.5, §10.4); until the user chooses, the first sound is the Athan sound (REQ-ALM-055). iOS notification and AlarmKit sounds are a sound's optional `iosClip`: a .caf of at most 29 s (REQ-ALM-034, ADR-013) that AthanKit copies to Library/Sounds/<soundId>.caf; cutting at phrase boundaries is checked by the audio pipeline, not here.

fajrVariantOf.description: soundId of the regular Athan this Fajr recording belongs to.

name.description: The name the voices page shows for this bundled sound (§15 D123); without it the page shows a generic name.

iosClip.description: UNNotificationSound plays aiff/wav/caf of at most 30 s, so the iOS clip is a .caf of at most 29 000 ms (REQ-ALM-034).
